target: Saya bekerja di perusahaan ini sejak tahun dua ribu dua puluh.
english: I have worked at this company since the year two thousand twenty.
grammar: Sejak = since a starting point: sejak tahun lalu = since last year. The verb itself does not change.

target: Kami tinggal di kompleks ini sejak anak pertama kami lahir.
english: We have lived in this housing complex since our first child was born.

target: Sejak pindah ke Jakarta, dia jarang pulang ke kampungnya.
english: Since moving to Jakarta, he rarely goes home to his hometown.

target: Hujan turun terus sejak subuh, jadi jalanan masih basah.
english: It has been raining nonstop since dawn, so the streets are still wet.
grammar: Terus after a verb = keeps on: hujan turun terus = it keeps raining.

target: Sejak rutin berolahraga pagi, tidur saya jauh lebih nyenyak.
english: Since exercising regularly in the morning, my sleep has been much more sound.

target: Dia belum makan apa-apa sejak siang karena rapatnya panjang sekali.
english: She hasn't eaten anything since midday because her meeting was very long.

target: Sejak harga bahan naik, ibu lebih sering memasak di rumah.
english: Since ingredient prices went up, Mom cooks at home more often.

target: Kami belum bertemu lagi sejak lulus kuliah lima tahun lalu.
english: We haven't met again since graduating from college five years ago.
grammar: Sejak also takes an event: sejak lulus = since graduating, sejak menikah = since getting married.

target: Sejak ada jalan tol baru, perjalanan ke bandara jauh lebih cepat.
english: Since there has been a new toll road, the trip to the airport is much faster.

target: Toko roti di ujung jalan itu buka sejak jam enam pagi.
english: That bakery at the end of the street is open from six in the morning.

target: Sejak kejadian itu, dia selalu mengunci pintu dua kali.
english: Since that incident, she always locks the door twice.

target: Adik saya suka menggambar sejak kecil, sekarang dia jadi desainer.
english: My little sister has liked drawing since she was small; now she has become a designer.

target: Selama musim hujan, kami jarang makan di luar rumah.
english: During the rainy season, we rarely eat outside the house.
grammar: Selama + time = during/for: selama liburan = during the holiday, selama dua jam = for two hours.

target: Dia bekerja di luar negeri selama tiga tahun sebelum kembali.
english: He worked abroad for three years before coming back.

target: Selama rapat tadi, semua ponsel peserta harus dimatikan.
english: During the meeting earlier, all the participants' phones had to be turned off.

target: Kami menginap di rumah paman selama liburan sekolah anak-anak.
english: We stayed at my uncle's house during the children's school holidays.

target: Selama saya di luar kota, tolong siram tanaman di teras.
english: While I am out of town, please water the plants on the terrace.

target: Jalan utama ditutup selama festival, jadi kami lewat gang kecil.
english: The main road is closed during the festival, so we go through a small alley.

target: Dia tidak boleh mengangkat barang berat selama tangannya belum sembuh.
english: He may not lift heavy things while his hand hasn't healed yet.
grammar: Selama + clause = while/as long as: selama tangannya belum sembuh = while his hand isn't healed yet.

target: Selama dua minggu ini, ayah harus ke dokter setiap hari Senin.
english: For these two weeks, Dad has to go to the doctor every Monday.

target: Listrik di rumah kami mati selama hampir lima jam kemarin.
english: The electricity at our house was out for almost five hours yesterday.

target: Selama mengantre di bank, saya sempat membaca satu bab novel.
english: While queuing at the bank, I managed to read one chapter of a novel.

target: Paket yang saya pesan minggu lalu belum datang sampai sekarang.
english: The package I ordered last week still hasn't arrived up to now.
grammar: Sampai sekarang = up to now: belum datang sampai sekarang = still hasn't come.

target: Kami berteman sejak sekolah dasar dan masih akrab sampai sekarang.
english: We have been friends since elementary school and are still close up to now.

target: Sampai sekarang saya belum berani menyetir sendiri di jalan tol.
english: Up to now I still haven't dared to drive alone on the toll road.

target: Resep sambal nenek masih dipakai keluarga kami sampai sekarang.
english: Grandma's sambal recipe is still used by our family to this day.

target: Dia sudah melamar ke banyak perusahaan, tapi belum ada jawaban sampai sekarang.
english: He has applied to many companies, but there has been no answer up to now.

target: Sampai sekarang, kunci gudang itu belum ketemu juga.
english: Up to now, that warehouse key still hasn't turned up.
grammar: Ketemu = everyday 'found/turn up': kuncinya belum ketemu = the key hasn't turned up.

target: Lagu itu terkenal sejak dulu dan masih sering diputar sampai sekarang.
english: That song has been famous since long ago and is still often played up to now.

target: Sampai sekarang nenek masih rutin berolahraga pagi di taman kompleks.
english: To this day Grandma still regularly exercises in the morning at the neighborhood park.

target: Kereta kami baru saja tiba di stasiun akhir.
english: Our train has just arrived at the final station.
grammar: Baru saja + verb = just did: baru saja tiba = just arrived.

target: Saya baru saja menutup laptop ketika bos menelepon.
english: I had just closed my laptop when the boss called.

target: Mereka baru saja pindah, jadi rumahnya masih penuh kardus.
english: They just moved, so their house is still full of cardboard boxes.

target: Barusan ada yang mengetuk pintu, tapi tidak ada orang di luar.
english: Just now someone knocked on the door, but there was no one outside.
grammar: Barusan = spoken 'just now'; in writing use baru saja. Barusan dia telepon. = He just called.

target: Kamu mendengar suara aneh itu barusan?
english: Did you hear that strange sound just now?
grammar: Mendengar = hear (it reaches your ears); mendengarkan = listen (on purpose).

target: Dia baru saja selesai mandi waktu tamunya datang.
english: She had just finished bathing when her guest arrived.

target: Barusan saya melihat dompetmu di atas meja makan.
english: Just now I saw your wallet on the dining table.

target: Kopi ini baru saja dibuat, hati-hati masih panas.
english: This coffee was just made; careful, it's still hot.

target: Baru saja hujan reda, sekarang mendung tebal lagi.
english: The rain just let up, and now it's heavily overcast again.

target: Barusan manajer mencari kamu di ruang rapat.
english: Just now the manager was looking for you in the meeting room.

target: Malam sebelumnya dia tidur larut, jadi hari ini dia bangun kesiangan.
english: The night before, he went to sleep late, so today he overslept.
grammar: Sebelumnya after a time word = the ... before: malam sebelumnya = the night before.

target: Kami sarapan dulu di warung; sesudahnya kami langsung ke stasiun.
english: We had breakfast first at a food stall; after that we went straight to the station.
grammar: Sesudahnya = after that, linking two events: makan dulu, sesudahnya berangkat = eat first, then leave.

target: Sehari sebelumnya, semua dokumen sudah saya siapkan di map merah.
english: The day before, I had already prepared all the documents in a red folder.

target: Dia sempat ragu sebelumnya, tapi akhirnya dia menerima tawaran itu.
english: He was hesitant before, but in the end he accepted the offer.
grammar: Sempat = at some point managed/happened to: sempat ragu = did hesitate for a while.

target: Rapatnya selesai jam empat; sesudahnya kami minum kopi bersama.
english: The meeting ended at four; after that we drank coffee together.

target: Saya pernah datang ke kota ini sebelumnya, tapi hanya sebentar.
english: I have come to this city before, but only briefly.

target: Cuci tangan dulu; sesudahnya baru kita makan bersama.
english: Wash your hands first; only after that do we eat together.
grammar: Baru after a time link = only then: sesudahnya baru makan = only after that do we eat.

target: Seminggu sebelumnya, kami sudah memesan meja untuk acara ulang tahun ibu.
english: A week before, we had already booked a table for Mom's birthday event.

target: Filmnya seru, tapi saya sudah menonton versi lamanya sebelumnya.
english: The movie is exciting, but I had already watched the old version before.

target: Kami menandatangani kontrak pagi itu; sesudahnya kami berfoto bersama.
english: We signed the contract that morning; after that we took a photo together.

target: Dia minum obat batuk; sesudahnya tenggorokannya terasa lebih enak.
english: He took cough medicine; after that his throat felt better.

target: Sebelumnya saya minta maaf kalau suara saya kurang jelas.
english: First of all, I apologize if my voice is not clear enough.
grammar: Sebelumnya can open politely: Sebelumnya, minta maaf... = First of all, apologies...

target: Ketika saya masih kuliah, saya sering begadang sebelum ujian.
english: When I was still in college, I often stayed up all night before exams.
grammar: Ketika = when, common in writing; in everyday speech people usually say waktu: waktu saya kuliah.

target: Ketika pintu pesawat dibuka, para penumpang langsung berdiri.
english: When the plane door was opened, the passengers immediately stood up.
grammar: Para + people-noun = plural group: para penumpang = the passengers.

target: Waktu lampu mati semalam, kami makan malam dengan lilin.
english: When the lights went out last night, we had dinner by candlelight.

target: Ketika hasil ujian diumumkan, seluruh kelas langsung ramai.
english: When the exam results were announced, the whole class immediately got noisy.

target: Waktu saya kecil, ayah sering membacakan cerita sebelum tidur.
english: When I was small, Dad often read me stories before bed.
grammar: Membacakan = read out for someone: membacakan cerita = read a story aloud (for them).

target: Ketika krisis terjadi, banyak toko kecil terpaksa tutup.
english: When the crisis happened, many small shops were forced to close.

target: Waktu kami sampai di puncak, kabutnya justru makin tebal.
english: When we reached the peak, the fog actually got thicker.

target: Ketika presentasi dimulai, tolong matikan mikrofon kalau tidak sedang bicara.
english: When the presentation starts, please turn off your microphone if you are not speaking.

target: Waktu harga tiket turun, kami langsung membeli dua kursi untuk Desember.
english: When ticket prices dropped, we immediately bought two seats for December.

target: Ketika bayi tidur siang, ibu menyetrika sambil mendengarkan radio.
english: When the baby naps, Mom irons while listening to the radio.

target: Waktu gempa kecil terasa, kami keluar lewat tangga darurat.
english: When the small earthquake was felt, we went out via the emergency stairs.

target: Ketika wawancara kerja, jawab setiap pertanyaan dengan tenang dan jujur.
english: During a job interview, answer every question calmly and honestly.

target: Dia menyapu halaman sambil menunggu cucian di mesin selesai.
english: She sweeps the yard while waiting for the laundry in the machine to finish.
grammar: Sambil = while (same person doing both): menyapu sambil menunggu = sweep while waiting.

target: Saya mencatat pesanan pelanggan sambil menjawab telepon yang terus berbunyi.
english: I write down customers' orders while answering the phone that keeps ringing.

target: Kakak menonton drama Korea sambil melipat pakaian yang baru kering.
english: My older sister watches a Korean drama while folding the freshly dried clothes.
grammar: Baru + adjective = freshly/just became: baru kering = just dried.

target: Kami duduk di teras sambil menikmati pisang goreng buatan nenek.
english: We sit on the terrace while enjoying Grandma's homemade fried bananas.

target: Sopir menunggu di depan hotel sambil mendengarkan berita di radio.
english: The driver waits in front of the hotel while listening to the news on the radio.

target: Sambil menunggu hujan reda, kami minum teh dan main kartu.
english: While waiting for the rain to stop, we drink tea and play cards.

target: Ibu menelepon nenek sambil mengaduk sup di dapur.
english: Mom calls Grandma while stirring the soup in the kitchen.

target: Jangan membalas pesan sambil menyetir; berhenti dulu di tempat aman.
english: Don't reply to messages while driving; stop first in a safe place.

target: Pas saya keluar rumah, hujan turun deras sekali.
english: Right when I left the house, it started raining very hard.
grammar: Pas = colloquial 'right when': pas saya keluar = right as I left. Written form: ketika/waktu.

target: Dia datang pas makanannya baru saja habis.
english: He arrived right when the food had just run out.

target: Pas kami tiba di loket, tiketnya ternyata sudah habis.
english: Right when we got to the ticket counter, it turned out the tickets were sold out.
grammar: Ternyata = it turns out: ternyata sudah habis = turns out they were sold out.

target: Listrik mati pas filmnya sedang seru-serunya.
english: The power went out right when the movie was at its most exciting.
grammar: Sedang + doubled adjective + -nya = at its peak: sedang seru-serunya = at its most exciting.

target: Pas gajian, dia langsung membayar semua tagihannya.
english: Right on payday, he immediately pays all his bills.
grammar: Gajian = payday (from gaji, salary): pas gajian = right when the pay comes in.

target: Telepon saya berbunyi pas rapat baru dimulai.
english: My phone rang right when the meeting had just started.

target: Pas liburan kemarin, harga kamar hotel naik dua kali lipat.
english: Right during the last holidays, hotel room prices doubled.

target: Kami sampai di halte pas busnya berangkat, jadi harus menunggu lagi.
english: We got to the bus stop right as the bus was leaving, so we had to wait again.

target: Setelah menabung dua tahun, mereka akhirnya membeli rumah kecil di pinggir kota.
english: After saving for two years, they finally bought a small house on the edge of town.
grammar: Akhirnya = finally, after effort or waiting: akhirnya selesai juga! = it's finally done!

target: Akhirnya saya menemukan kacamata itu di bawah bantal sofa.
english: I finally found the glasses under the sofa cushion.

target: Setelah macet dua jam, kami akhirnya sampai di rumah nenek.
english: After being stuck in traffic for two hours, we finally arrived at Grandma's house.

target: Dia akhirnya berani mengajukan kenaikan gaji ke atasannya.
english: She finally dared to ask her boss for a raise.
grammar: Mengajukan = put forward/request: mengajukan kenaikan gaji = ask for a raise.

target: Setelah lama ragu, ayah akhirnya menjual motor tuanya.
english: After hesitating for a long time, Dad finally sold his old motorbike.

target: Antrean panjang itu akhirnya bergerak setelah loket kedua dibuka.
english: The long queue finally moved after the second counter was opened.
grammar: Antrean = the queue (antre + -an): antrean panjang = a long line.

target: Akhirnya kami menemukan warung yang masih buka setelah berkeliling hampir sejam.
english: We finally found a food stall that was still open after going around for almost an hour.

target: Setelah tiga kali gagal, dia akhirnya lulus ujian menyetir.
english: After failing three times, he finally passed the driving test.

target: Awalnya saya gugup, tapi akhirnya wawancaranya berjalan lancar.
english: At first I was nervous, but in the end the interview went smoothly.
grammar: Awalnya ... akhirnya frames a story: awalnya susah, akhirnya terbiasa = hard at first, used to it in the end.

target: Awalnya dia menolak, akhirnya dia ikut juga ke acara itu.
english: At first he refused; in the end he came along to the event after all.
grammar: Juga after the verb = after all/finally: ikut juga = ended up joining after all.

target: Awalnya kami tersesat, akhirnya seorang warga mengantar kami sampai jalan besar.
english: At first we got lost; in the end a local resident took us to the main road.

target: Awalnya rasanya aneh, tapi akhirnya saya malah suka makanan pedas.
english: At first it tasted strange, but in the end I actually came to like spicy food.
grammar: Malah = contrary to expectation: saya malah suka = I actually ended up liking it.

target: Awalnya mereka hanya berteman, akhirnya mereka menikah tahun lalu.
english: At first they were just friends; in the end they got married last year.

target: Awalnya proyek ini kecil, akhirnya seluruh tim ikut terlibat.
english: At first this project was small; in the end the whole team got involved.

target: Awalnya cuaca cerah, akhirnya kami pulang cepat karena angin kencang.
english: At first the weather was clear; in the end we went home early because of strong wind.

target: Awalnya adik takut naik sepeda, akhirnya dia bisa berkeliling kompleks sendiri.
english: At first my little brother was afraid to ride a bike; in the end he could ride around the complex alone.

target: Awalnya saya hanya mau melihat-lihat, akhirnya saya membeli dua pasang sepatu.
english: At first I only wanted to browse; in the end I bought two pairs of shoes.
grammar: Melihat-lihat = browse/look around: hanya mau melihat-lihat = just looking.

target: Awalnya hanya gerimis, akhirnya banjir kecil menutup jalan depan sekolah.
english: At first it was only drizzling; in the end a small flood covered the road in front of the school.

target: Dulu saya tinggal di Medan sebelum pindah ke Bogor.
english: I used to live in Medan before moving to Bogor.
grammar: Dulu at the start = used to: Dulu saya tinggal di Medan. = I used to live in Medan.

target: Dulu di sini sawah luas, sekarang sudah jadi perumahan besar.
english: There used to be wide rice fields here; now it has become a big housing estate.
grammar: Dulu ... sekarang contrasts past and present: dulu sepi, sekarang ramai = used to be quiet, now busy.

target: Ayah dulu perokok berat, sekarang dia rajin lari pagi.
english: Dad used to be a heavy smoker; now he diligently jogs in the morning.

target: Dulu kami harus mengantre di bank, sekarang semuanya lewat aplikasi.
english: We used to have to queue at the bank; now everything is via an app.
grammar: Lewat = via/through: lewat aplikasi = through an app.

target: Nenek dulu berjualan kue di pasar dekat stasiun.
english: Grandma used to sell cakes at the market near the station.
grammar: Berjualan = to sell as one's trade: berjualan kue = sell cakes (for a living).

target: Dulu tiket bioskop murah sekali, sekarang harganya naik terus.
english: Movie tickets used to be very cheap; now the price keeps going up.

target: Kakak dulu takut gelap, sekarang dia malah suka mendaki malam-malam.
english: My older brother used to be afraid of the dark; now he actually likes hiking late at night.

target: Dulu kantor kami hanya punya lima karyawan, sekarang sudah ratusan.
english: Our office used to have only five employees; now there are hundreds.

target: Dulu orang menulis surat panjang, sekarang semuanya lewat pesan singkat.
english: People used to write long letters; now everything is via short messages.

target: Dulu kampung ini sepi, sekarang ramai karena ada kampus baru.
english: This village used to be quiet; now it is busy because there is a new campus.

target: Saya dulu benci sayur, sekarang saya makan sayur setiap hari.
english: I used to hate vegetables; now I eat vegetables every day.

target: Dulu anak-anak kampung ini mandi di sungai setiap sore.
english: The children of this village used to bathe in the river every afternoon.

target: Tadi pagi saya bangun kesiangan, jadi saya berangkat tanpa sarapan.
english: This morning I woke up late, so I left without breakfast.
grammar: Kesiangan = too late in the morning: bangun kesiangan = overslept.

target: Kami berangkat subuh, istirahat sebentar di jalan, dan tiba di Bandung sebelum siang.
english: We left at dawn, rested a moment on the way, and arrived in Bandung before midday.

target: Awalnya dia hanya membantu di dapur, lama-lama dia belajar memasak, akhirnya dia membuka warung sendiri.
english: At first she only helped in the kitchen; over time she learned to cook; in the end she opened her own food stall.
grammar: Lama-lama = over time/gradually: lama-lama dia belajar = over time she learned.

target: Sejak pindah ke kota besar, dia jarang berolahraga, akhirnya badannya mudah lelah.
english: Since moving to the big city, he rarely exercises; in the end his body tires easily.

target: Waktu kecil saya sering menginap di rumah paman; sekarang rumah itu sudah dijual.
english: When I was small I often stayed over at my uncle's house; now that house has been sold.

target: Ketika tamu datang, ibu masih memasak, jadi saya yang membuka pintu.
english: When the guests arrived, Mom was still cooking, so it was I who opened the door.
grammar: Yang after the doer = the one who: saya yang membuka pintu = I'm the one who opened the door.

target: Saya menunggu sampai jam lima; sesudahnya saya pulang karena kantor sudah sepi.
english: I waited until five o'clock; after that I went home because the office was already quiet.
grammar: Sampai = until: menunggu sampai jam lima = wait until five.

target: Barusan hujan deras sekali; sekarang matahari muncul seperti tidak terjadi apa-apa.
english: Just now it rained very hard; now the sun has come out as if nothing happened.

target: Dulu kami satu sekolah, lalu dia pindah ke luar kota, dan minggu lalu kami bertemu lagi.
english: We used to be at the same school, then he moved out of town, and last week we met again.

target: Selama perjalanan pulang, anak-anak tidur, jadi mobil terasa tenang sampai kami tiba.
english: During the trip home, the kids slept, so the car felt calm until we arrived.

target: Pas saya mau membayar, saya sadar dompet saya tertinggal di kantor.
english: Right when I was about to pay, I realized my wallet had been left behind at the office.
grammar: Tertinggal = accidentally left behind: dompet saya tertinggal = my wallet got left behind.

target: Sejak sistem baru dipasang, laporan mingguan selesai lebih cepat dan tim jarang lembur.
english: Since the new system was installed, weekly reports get done faster and the team rarely works overtime.

target: Awalnya kami salah naik bus, akhirnya kami turun di terminal dan naik ojek ke hotel.
english: At first we took the wrong bus; in the end we got off at the terminal and took a motorbike taxi to the hotel.
grammar: Salah + verb = do wrongly: salah naik bus = take the wrong bus.

target: Ketika pesawat mendarat, hujan baru saja reda, jadi kami menunggu sebentar di dalam.
english: When the plane landed, the rain had just stopped, so we waited a moment inside.

target: Dulu saya menulis catatan harian setiap malam; sekarang saya menulis hanya ketika ada hari penting.
english: I used to write a diary every night; now I write only when there is an important day.
